text:
Aisha K.: quick heads-up — saw a pattern where high-priority inbound leads get assigned to the HS round-robin but SF owner mapping lags, causing a handoff SLA breach :alarm_clock:
Gabe M.: ugh, is this timezone/latency or the enrichment step?
Aisha K.: looks like enrichment delay. HS enrichment webhook sometimes takes >30s and SF sync job runs on receipt so owner_id ends up null, SF creates unowned lead and then claim takes >15m
Priya S.: are we using the new priority field seed in hubspot to bias RR? that could make some work queue clump
Aisha K.: yes — we added `priority_bucket` to the RR seed last week. In normal flow that's fine but with slow enrichment the seed gets calculated before enrichment fills `company_size` and `urgency` -> skew
Tom (ops): can we change ordering so enrichment finishes before assignment? any infra cost?
Gabe M.: easiest short-term: delay RR assignment by a short TTL to let enrichment finish. eg 45s debounce for leads with `enrichment_pending=true`
Priya S.: agree. fallback plan: if SF owner null after 2m, assign to overflow queue with SLA 10m and notify AE team channel
Aisha K.: draft of the change I tested locally:
```
if (lead.enrichment_pending) {
  setTimeout(assignRoundRobin, 45000)
} else {
  assignRoundRobin()
}
```
Gabe M.: looks fine. Tom — can you add metric tags for `assignment_delay` and `enrichment_latency` so we can monitor regressions?
Tom (ops): yup. will add to pipeline and a Grafana panel. also adding an alert: rate of SF unowned leads > 3/hr -> page oncall
hs-sync-bot: sync job completed for lead 81234 (owner: overflow_pool) :white_check_mark:
Priya S.: messaging change: update handoff playbook to say "if lead assigned to overflow_pool, AE oncall gets a Slack DM and ticket created in SF" — i'll draft language
Aisha K.: thanks — can we ship the 45s debounce + metrics + playbook update as a single patch? roll it canary Monday morning?
Gabe M.: yes. schedule canary 09:00 PT Mon, 10% traffic for 30m, then scale
Tom (ops): deploying to staging now. will post results in this thread
Aisha K.: ok perfect. tagging @Priya S. for playbook PR and @Gabe M. for rollout notes :thumbsup:
